note: Written 2026-09-24 by the chat judgement from project-requirements/ and docs/pre-rig-master-plan.md Phase 1; statuses from STATUS.md. Only the judgement session or the user changes a status; a milestone becomes done only with evidence paths.

requirements.title: Split the while loop after 'Done Picking Beads?' into multiple parallel while loops
Motor control runs in its own loop (already parallel in the original)
Motor reading out of the frame loop (a frame-rate bottleneck)
Camera acquisition in its own loop
Scheduler for the motor control plan in its own loop
Merging and saving data in its own loop
No frame loss ('Total Lost Frames') with many beads or maximum frame rate
The original's computation is unchanged: same inputs give the same X/Y/Z (rule 1a)
GPU-accelerated tracking path, built first and the default
No VISA/serial call on the frame acquisition path (rule 1c)
